thread:
maria-partnerships: Heads up — vendor just messaged. ETA slippage on GPU shipment we reserved for next week's EU Dedicated feature launch. We booked 40 A100s; manifest shows a hold. Need triage.

jake-logistics: How big is the slippage? any units actually released yet?

maria-partnerships: Manifest says 12 units held at EU customs, vendor estimates +7d earliest. They flagged paperwork mismatch.

alex-eng: Impact: planned scale 8→32 replicas for the rollout. Losing 12 nodes puts our latency SLO at risk during peak. We need a backfill plan ASAP.

sophia-sales: We promised Acme the committed capacity for launch. Can Partnerships push vendor for prioritization? Sales needs options to offer to the customer (credits, partial launch, delay).

maria-partnerships: Options on table: 1) vendor expedite/charter (expensive), 2) short-term marketplace reservations / partner credits, 3) reallocate internal spare pool (affects staging), 4) stagger launch. Which do we want to pursue in parallel?

inventory-bot: Inventory snapshot — EU free GPUs: 6, US spare pool: 10 (cross-region transfer ETA 48h).

kevin-cs: Support should prep a customer-facing contingency note. If we need to offer credits, let me know numbers.

alex-eng: We can temporarily reduce per-rep memory footprint (trim KV caches) to squeeze more replicas, but expect ~10-15% perf hit. Ops sign-off needed.

jake-logistics: Reached out to vendor contact for manifest photos and customs docs (ref 0034). Asked for confirmation within 3h. Also checking expedited freight options.

maria-partnerships: I'm also opening a request with OrionCloud marketplace for 20 short-term reservation credits — they asked for a PO and justification. Drafting now.

sophia-sales: I'll prepare a concise contingency one-pager for Acme (options + timeline). Prefer to avoid asking for a launch delay.

ops-deploy-bot: Scheduled canary scale job queued for 1766200000 — no action taken by ops.

kevin-cs: I'll author a templated support message and keep it high-level: "temporary capacity reallocation; no data at risk; working on prioritized replacement."

(3h later)
jake-logistics: Vendor update: customs released 6 units this morning after paperwork update. They can airfreight additional 6 next day if we cover expedite fee.

inventory-bot: Updated inventory — EU free GPUs: 12 (after partial release), US spare pool: 10.

maria-partnerships: Good — that covers half the shortfall. Still short ~6 for the launch target. Marketplace request for 20 credits submitted (PO attached). Waiting on partner approval.

sophia-sales: Escalating with Acme CSM now, sharing contingency one-pager and asking for go/no-go on partial launch.

alex-eng: If we accept the 6-unit shortfall, we should throttle background batch jobs and reserve capacity for real-time paths. I can set config changes, need deployment window.

maria-partnerships: OK — plan for now: jake pursue expedited 6 (we pay fee), sophia hold customer cadence and try partial launch option, kevin prep customer comms, alex stage perf mitigations. Reconvene 2pm UTC. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

kevin-cs: Acknowledged — drafting message now.
